_note: Session K1a (GDD 4.10 'K1's questions'): the Career tab's data. `milestones` = what goes on the timeline (CareerSystem finds them from the results, the standards, the rankings and what the other systems record), `round_times` = the times a Finnish runner talks about (the first time under each), `records` = the Finnish records (times only, with a source and the date it was read; below senior level NO NAMES, GDD rule 'no real people below senior level'), `path` = the long path's wording. Every number is a fact of the game's own data or a fact with a source.

round_times._note: The 800 m times a runner counts their career by: a round time is a time with a zero or a five at the end of the minute (2:30, 2:20, 2:10 ...). Men: from 2:30 (the SM limit of a 15-year-old is 2:21) to the elite; women: from 2:50 (the SM limit of a 15-year-old girl is 2:35).

records._note: Finnish 800 m records. Senior: tilastopaja.fi 'Suomen ennätykset' (the official list kept by SUL), read 2026-11-01; the outdoor marks also agree with the English Wikipedia list. Age classes: only the M14 outdoor record is a source the game could verify (an MTV Uutiset story of an athletics federation release: the 14-year-old boy's record 1:59.89; the older mark was 2:00.1 from 1979); the other age classes (M15, M17, M19, N14-N19) are NOT in the data because the official class tables of SUL / tilastopaja could not be read on 2026-11-01 (the SUL site refused the connection, tilastopaja's class tabs are not reachable by address). They are to be added with their source when read: the milestone and the reputation points for 'near the record' use a class only when it has a row here. No name below senior level is ever stored. The senior names are those of the official list.

mtv_m14.title: MTV Uutiset: a 14-year-old boy breaks one of Finland's oldest age-class records in the 800 m (1:59.89), from a SUL release

milestones._note: Kinds on the timeline. `pt` = the icon (assets/icons). A milestone is found once and keeps the date it happened; the id is the key that stops it from being found twice.

path._note: The long path (the coach's 2-3-year view, from what the game has): the application to the urheilulukio, the real limits of your ages (standards.json) for the next three seasons, and the school years. `gain` = how many seconds a runner of that age typically gains in a year (market.json offers.yearly_gain): a rough pace, not a promise.
